ROLLA

A downloadable game for Windows

We interrupt this broadcast to bring you breaking news.

The News Channel has received and verified harrowing footage from a scene in downtown that appears to be feature a being of an unknown origin. The creature has already caused inestimable amount of damage to crucial infrastructure and has claimed a number of casualties. We now take you to our eye on the sky at the scene of this horrific tragedy. We advise that parents with young children take precautions as the following footage will be gruesome and may shock younger viewers.


Here at the scene to report the latest on the otherworldly disaster unfolding right before our eyes. It would seem that the being in question gelatinous pulpy substance, nothing that I've ever witnessed in my entire life. Its already claimed countless lives and as you can see from our footage caused mass destruction here in downtown. The monster seems to be eating or absorbing everything it comes in contact with. It is unclear at this stage whether this being has a sense of awareness or mind as it simply seems to be rolling and destroying everything in its path. Law enforcement, first responders and the military are arriving on the scene as we speak, working together to evacuate civilians and keep the monster at bay.

One thing is for sure, however. Whatever this monster is, it seems to be expanding at a rapid rate. Where did this thing come from? And can we stop it?


ROLLA is a B-movie inspired horror arcade destruction game about survival. An extra-terrestrial monster has escaped human captivity and is now rampaging in different locations around the world. The humans are simply calling it ROLLA as all it does is roll, eat and destroy everything in its path. The more it eats, the larger it grows. Humans try to destroy it with everything that they've got: bullets, missiles and fire. The monster can mutate in its fight for survival but wil it be enough? Can you keep ROLLA alive?

Features:

  • Easy and accessible control scheme - play with joypad, keyboard and mouse or just keyboard
  • Levels - different locations around the world
  • Complete Missions - unique tasks and collectibles in each level
  • Power-ups - increase your chances of survival through mutations enabled by a variety of power-ups
  • Online Leaderboards - do you have what it takes to climb to the top?
  • Blood-pumping Original Soundtrack - intense and imposing synth score composed entirely by the developer
